title: צ
content:
[Str6631] † [צֶאֱצָא] n.m.:Jb 27:14 only pl., issue, offspring, produce (NoZMG 1886, 723 comps. ضِيءضِِيءٌ origin, root, stock)—1. offspring of men, abs. הַצֶּאֱצָאִים וְהַצְּפִעוֺת Is 22:24; elsewhere only Is:2, Is:3 and Job: cstr. צֶאֱעָאֵי מֵעֶיְ Is 48:19 (‖זַרְעְֲ); sf. צֶאֱצָאַי Jb 31:8, צֶאֱצָאֶיְ 5:25 (‖זַרְעְֲ), Is 44:3 (‖ id.); חֶאֱחָיָאו Jb 27:14 (‖בָּנָיו); צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ ם 21:8 (‖זַרְעָם) Is 61:9 (‖ id.), 65:23. 2. prpdice of earth, sf. תֵּבל וְכָל־צֶאֱצָאֶָיהָ Is 34:1; הָאָרֶץ וְצי 42:5.

[Str4161] † I. מוֺצָא n.m.:Ho 6:3 place or act of going forth, issue, export, souce, spring;—abs. ´מ Jb 28:1, Psalm 75:7; cstr. ´מ Nu 30:13 + 9 t.; מֹצָא Jb 38:27, Dn 9:25; sf. מוֺצָאְֲ 2 S 3:25; מֹצָאוֺ Ho 6:3; מוֺצָאוֺ Psalm 19:7; pl. cstr. מוֺצָאֵי Is 41:18 + 5 t.; sf. מוֺצָאָיו Ez 43:11; מוֺצָאֵיהֶם Nu 33:2, 33:2; מוֺצָאֵיהֶן Ez 42:11; —1. a going forth: a. the act, of ´י Ho 6:3; of the sun = rising Psalm 19:7 (v. יצא 1 f); of man 2 S 3:25 (opp. מָבוֺא Kt); דָּבָר ´מ Dn 9:25 going forth of a command. b. concrete, מוֺצָאֵי גּוֺלָה Ez 12:4 goings forth of exile, i.e. those going forth into exile (in sim.). c. way out, exit: concrete, of chambers in temple Ez 42:11, 43:11 (opp. מוֺבָיָאו); מוֺצָאֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ Ez 44:5 (opp. מְבוֺא הַבַּיִת). 2. that which goes forth: a. utteranc of mouth or lips (esp. of solemn or formal speech), ´מוֺצָא פִי־י Dt 8:3; ´שְפָתַי מ Je 17:16, Psalm 89:35; so Dt 23:24, Nu 30:13 (P). b. export of horses 1 K 10:23 = 2 Ch 1:16. 3. place of going forth: a. source or spring of water 2 K 2:21, Is 58:11 (in sim.) Psalm 107:33 (‖נְהָרוֺת), v:35 (‖אֲגַמ־מים) = Is 41:18 (‖ id.); מוֺצָא מֵימֵי גִיחוֺן הָעֶלְיוֺן 2 Ch 32:30. b. place of departure of Israel on march Nu 33:2, 33:2 (P). c. מוֺצָא = east (place of sun's going forth) Psalm 75:7 (opp. מַעֲרָב); zeugmatically, 65:9 מוֺצָאֵי בֹּקֶר וָעֶרֶב i.e. the east and the west (cf. the two Orients, Qor 43:37). d. place whence silver comes = mine Jb 28:1; וּלְהַצְמִיחַ מֹצָא רֶשֶׁא 38:27 and to cause the growing-place (others, the growth) of young grass to sprout.

[Str4162] † II. מוֺצָא n.pr.m. 1. son of Caleb by Ephah his concubine 1 Ch 2:46, LXX Ιωσα(ν), LXXL Μουσα. 2. a descendant of Saul 1 Ch 8:36, 8:37 (LXX Μαισα) = 9:42, 9:43 LXX Μασσα; LXXL in both Μωσα).

[Str4163] † [מוֺצָאָה] n.f. only pl.: a. Mi 5:1 מוֺצָאוֺתָיו (cf. future ruler out of Bethlehem), his origin. b. 2 K 10:27 Qr מוֺצָאוֺת places of going out to, i.e. a privy (cf. Ar. مَخْرَجٌ; Germ. Abtritt), euphemistically for Kt מַחֲרָאוֺת.

[Str8444] † [תּוֺצָאָה] n.f. outgoing, extremity, souce (?), escape; only pl.; chiefly P and late;—abs. תוֺצָאוֺת Psalm 68:21; cstr. תוֺצְאוֺת Pr 4:23 + Jos 18:19 Qr (Kt תוצאותיו); תּוֺצְאֹת Nu 34:8, Ez 48:30; תֹּצְאוֺת Jos 15:4 + 2 t.; sf. תּוֺצְאֹתָיו Nu 34:4 + 3 t.; תֹּצְאֹתָיו Jos 15:7 + 8 t. + 16:3 Qr (Kt תצאתו); תּוֺצְאוֺתָם 1 Ch 5:16; —1. outgoing, extremity of border of territory Jos 16:3, 17:18 (both JE), elsewhere P: Nu 34:4, 34:5, 34:8, 34:9, 34:12, Jos 15:4, 15:7, 15:11, 16:8, 17:9, 18:12, 18:14, 18:19, 19:14, 19:22, 19:20, 19:33; outskirts of city Ez 48:20, cf. 1 Ch 5:16. 2. חַיִּים ´ת Pr 4:23 (? read מוֺצְאוֺת) sources of life. 3. ´לַמָּוֶת ת Psalm 68:21 escapes from (lit. for, i.e. in view of) death.

content:

content:

content:

Hiph. Impf. 3 ms. וַיָּצֵץ צִיץ Nu 17:23 it put forth blossoms (of rod; —ֵ perhaps from ‖וַיֹּצֵא פֶרַח).

Köii. l, 60);—1. blossom, flower, Nu 17:23 (P; of Aaron's rod); (fig. of man Is 40:7, 40:8 (both ´נָבֵל צ; ‖חָצִיר), cf. sim. צִיץ הַשָּדֶה v:6 (‖ id.), Psalm 103:15, and ´צ alone Jb 14:2; נֹבֵל ´צ Is 28:1 (fig. of Samaria), so prob. also v:4 (for MT ´צִיצַת נ; so Marti); פְּטוּרֵי צִצִּים, as ornaments of temple 1 K 6:18, 6:29, 6:32, 6:35. 2. shining thing, plate of gold, constituting the diadem on front of high priest's mitre, Lv 8:9, Ex 28:36, 39:30 (all P).—I, III. צִיץ, v. p. 851 infr.

title: I צוּק
content:

Hiph. constrain, bring into straits, press upon (NH צוּק be distressed (rare), Hiph. = BH; Ar. ضَاقَ (ي) be narrow, tight, so Eth. ጦቀ፡; Aram. עִיק, ܥܳܩ; Chr Pal. ܨܘܩ);—Pf. 3 fs. הֵצִיקָה Ju 16:16, sf. הֱצִיקַתְהוּ 14:17, נִי- Jb 32:18 (Gi v:19); 1 s. וַהֲצִיקוֺתִ֫י consec. Pers. 14:17; constrain (to speak) Jb 32:18 (sf. Pers.); elsewhere of bringing into straits a city or people, c. ל, Is 29:2, 29:7, so 7:6 (reading וּנְצִיקֶנָּה for MT וּנְקִיצֶנָּה), Thes Che Du Gr Marti, cf. formula לְ ´בְּמָצוֺר וּבְמָצוֺק אֲשֶׁר יָצ Dt 28:53, 28:55, 28:57, Je 19:9; pt. abs. הַמֵּצִיק Is 51:13, 51:13 the oppressor.

title: צוּק
content:
[Str6694] †II [צוּק] vb. pour out, melt (‖יצק);—Qal Pf. 3 pl. (acc. to Thes al.) צָקוּן Is 26:16, but v. infr.; Impf. 3 ms. וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה Jb 28:2 (rd. perh. יָצוּקוּ, v. Bu) and stone (ore, men) melt it into copper; צוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵי־שָׁמֶן Jb 29:6 the rock used to pour out beside me streams of oil.—Is 26:16 (as above) must mean they poured out (uttered) a whisper (לַחַשׁ; i. e. prayer); but form most improb.; Koppe Gr Di Du al. prop. צְקוֺן לַחַשׁ (from assumed צָקוֺן, I. צוק) = constraint of (like that of) magic; < Houb Kit צָֽעֲקוּ בְלַחַץ ´וגו, or CheHpt צָעַקְנוּ מִלַּחַץ כִּי מוּסָֽרְ לָנוּ.

I. חור (√of foll.; cf. possibly Ar. صَارَ (و) cause to incline, learn; NH = BH (rare), so Aram. ܨܘܪܐ (cf. Köii.1, 90), צַוְּרָא).

Ju 5:30 (rd. perh. צַוָּארַי for רֵי-), elsewh. in Gn usu. pl. intens., of individual, ´נָפַל עַל־ח 45:14 (E), 46:29, 33:4 (Qr; Kt sg.), so ´בָּכָה עַל־ח 45:14, 46:29 (all J); חֶלְקַת צַוַּארָיו 27:16 smooth part of neck (J); neck of beautiful woman Ct 4:4, 7:5; neck as pressed by foot of conqueror Jos 10:24, 10:24 (JE); place of yoke Gn 27:40 (sg.; J), Dt 28:48, Is 10:27, Je 27:2, 27:8, 27:11, 27:12, 28:10, 28:11, 28:12, 28:14, 30:8; of transgressions as yoke La 1:14; place of bonds Is 52:2; of bearing load, Ne 3:5 (fig.), hence calamity as burden Mi 2:3; neck as smitten with sword Ez 21:34; ´עַד־ח as measurement of height (depth; in fig.) Is 8:8, 30:8, Hb 3:13; עָתָק ´בְּח fig. Psalm 75:6 speak not with arrogant neck (si Vera l.; but rd. perh. בַּצּוּר against the Rock, LXX. κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, Bae Hup-Now Che Kau); of wicked, rushing against God Jb 15:26.—עַל־צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדָּ֔פְנוּ La 5:5 is dubious; Matthes Löhr Bae ´עֹל עַל־וגו; Bu ´עֹל צַוּ, and הֲדָפָנוּ or יֶהְדְּפֵנוּ for ´נִר. 2. neck of animals, camels (wearing ornaments) Ju 8:21, 8:26; heifer Ho 10:11 (i. e. place of yoke, in fig. of Ephr.); horse Jb 39:19, crocodile 41:14.

title: צוּר
content:
[Str6696] II צוּר vb.confine, bind, besiege (NH id., wrap (rare); Aram. צוּר besiege, beleaguer);—Qal Pf. 2 ms.וְצַרְתָּ֫ Dt 14:25, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. וַיָּ֫צַר 1 K 20:1 +, 2 ms. תָּצוּר Dt 20:19, etc.; Imv. fs. צוּרִ֫י Is 21:2 (after עֲלִי Köi. 444, cf. Ges§ 72 s); Inf. cstr. לָצוּר 1 S 23:8; Pt. pl. צָרִים 1 K 15:27 +;—1. confine, secure (‖ I. צרר), acc. rei + ב of receptacle Dt 14:25, 2 K 5:23, Ez 5:3; complem. om. 2 K 12:11. 2. shut in, besiege, c. עַל of city 2 S 11:1, 1 K 15:27, 16:17, 20:1, 2 K 6:24, 6:25, 17:5, 18:9, 24:11, Is 29:3 (+ acc. of siege-works), Je 32:2, 37:5, 39:9, Dt 20:12, Ez 4:3, Dn 1:1; c. עַל Pers. (within city) 2 S 20:15, 2 K 16:5, Je 21:4, 21:9; c. אֶל of city (for עַל) Dt 20:19; c. אֶל Pers. 1 S 23:8; c. אֵת of city only 1 Ch 20:1 (‖ 2 S 11:1 supr.); abs. Is 21:2.—הִנָּם צָרִים אֶת־הָעִיר עָלֶיְ Ju 9:31 is corrupt; FrankenbRichterbuch 28 Bu GFMHpt Now מְעִרִים inciting against. 3. shut up, enclose: נָצוּר עָלֶיהָ לוּחַ אָרֶז Ct 8:9 (על of maid [under fig. of door] + acc. mater., cf. Is 29:3 supr.); c. sf. Pers. Psalm 139:5 (fig., ´י subj.).

[Str4692,4693] †מָצוֺר n.[m.] siege-enclosure, siege, entrenchment;—alw. ´מ abs., exc. cstr. מְצוֺר Ez 4:7 sf. מְצוּרְֶָ v:8; —1. siege שָם עָלֵינוּ ´מ Mi 4:14 he hath laid siege to us, cf. ´וְנָתַתָּ֫ עָלֶיהָ מ Ez 4:2; ´בּוֺא בַמּ is come into a state of siege Dt 20:19, 2 K 24:10, 25:2, Je 52:5, cf. ´וְהָֽיְתָה בַמּ Ez 4:3; ´יוֺשֶׁבֶת֯י בַּמּ Je 10:17; ´מְצוֺר יְרו Ez 4:7 siege of Jerus., but also ´עַל־יְרו´מ Zc 12:2; ´יְמֵי מ of duration of siege Ez 4:8, 5:2; ´מֵי מ Na 3:14 water for a siege; in phr. וּבְמָצוֺק ´בְּמ in the siege and stress Dt 28:53, 28:55, 28:57, Je 19:9. 2. enclosure, i.e. siege-works Dt 20:20; late = ram-part Zc 9:3, ´עִיר מ entrenched city Psalm 31:22 (al. besieged), 60:11 (‖ 108:11 מִבְצָר ´ע), cf. 2 Ch 8:5; ´עָרִים לְמ 11:5, בִּירוּשָׁלַם ´ישְׁבִים בְּמ 32:10; ´מ Hb 2:1 acc. to most (‖מִשְׁמֶרֶת); but We der. fr. נצר, i.e. watch-tower, Now conj. מִצְפֶּה (cf. וַאֲחַפֶּה foll.); >Buhl conj. מְצָד.—מ n.pr.terr. v. p. 566.

[Str4694] †מְצוּרָה n.f. siege-works, rampart;—abs. ´מ Na 2:2, 2 Ch 14:5; pl. מְצוּרוֺת 2 Ch 11:11 +, מְצֻרֹת Is 29:3, etc.;—1. siege-works Is 29:3. 2. rampart ´נָצוֺר מ Na 2:2 guard the rampart / (‖חַפֵּה דֶרֶח; We Now der. fr. נצר, i.e. keep watch !), 2 Ch 11:11, עָרֵי מְצוּרָה 14:5 fortified cities, so מְצוּרוֺת(הַ)עָרַי v:10, v:23, 12:4, 21:3.

content: [Str6696] †III. [צוּר] vb. shew hostility to, treat as foe (c. acc. Pers.) (akin to II. צרר, to which SS assign the forms, but cf. Ar. ضَارَ act unjustly, also defraud; Syr. ܥܝܳܪܬܳܐ, rival wife);—Qal Pf. 1 s. וְצַרְתִּ֫י אֶת־צֹרֲרֶיְ Ex 23:22 (subj. ´י; ‖וְאָיַבְתִּ֫י אֶת־אֹיְבֶיְ); Impf. 2 ms. אַל־תָּ֫צַר אֶת־מוֺאָב Dt 2:9; 2 mpl. sf. אַל־תְּצֻרֵם v:19; Pt. הַצָּרִים אוֺתָם Est 8:11.

content:

Th; 1 S. Sf. אצורך Je 1:5 Kt, v. יצר

content:
[Str6740] † [צָלָה] vb. roast flesh (NH id.; so Ar. ጸለወ፡ (ܨܠܚ), Eth. صَلَا);—Qal Impf. 3 ms. יִצְלֶה צָלִי Is 44:16 he roasteth a roast; 1 s. אֶצְלֶה בָשָר v:19; Inf. cstr. לִצְלוֺת 1 S 2:15 give flesh (בָּשָר) to roast.

title: I צָלַח
content: [Str6743] † I.[ צָלַח] vb. rush;— (Thes al. cp. Targum צְלַח, Syr. ܨܠܰܚ, cleave, penetrate, then advance, v. foll.);—Qal Pf. 3 fs. וְחָֽלְתָה consec. 1 S 10:6; 3 pl. צָֽלְחוּ 2 S 19:18; Impf. 3 ms. יִצְלַח Am 5:6 (v. infr.), 3 fs. וַתִּצְלַח Ju 14:6 +;—rush, הַיַּרְדֵּן ´וְח 2 S 19:18 they rushed into the Jordan (dub., v. Dr HPS), דָּאֵשׁ בֵּית יוֹסֵף ´יִח Am 5:6 lest he rush like fire upon the house of Joseph (or O house, etc. GASm; Now conj. יַצִּית בָּאֵשׁ); esp. of sudden possession by (אֱהִֽים) ´י, c. רוּחַ עַל, c. Pers. Ju 14:6 the Spirit…rushed upon him, so v:19, 15:14, 1 S 10:6, 10:10, 11:6; c. אֶל Pers. 16:13 and (of רָעָה ´רוּחַ צ) 18:10.

title: II צָלֵחַ
content:
[Str6743] † II. [צָלֵחַ, צָלַח] vb. advance, prosper (NH id.; Ph. Pi. causat. in n.pr.; Ar. ܨܠܘܚܝܬܐ be good condition< cf. Sab. תצלךְ Sab Denkm93; Aram. צְלַח, ፅኣሕል፡ prosper );—Qal Pf. 3 fs. צָלֵָחָה Je 12:1; Impf. 3 ms. יִצְלַח Je 13:7 +, etc.; Imv. ms. צְלַח;—prosper, of way of wicked Je 12:1 cf. Nu 14:41, Is 53:10, 54:17, Ez 17:9, 17:10, Dn 11:27; c. ל rei, = be good for anything Je 13:7, 13:10, Ez 15:4; subj. Pers., abs., Je 22:30, 22:20, Ez 17:15, Psalm 45:5 be successful ! וַתִּצְלְחִי לִמְלוּבָה Ez 16:13 and thou didst prosper to royalty (dub.; del. LXX Co Toy; >StaZAW vi (1886), 337 f. Krae לִמְלָאכָה i.e. harlotry). Hiph. Pf. 3 ms. הִצְלִיחַ Gn 24:21, 2 ms. וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֫ 1 Ch 22:11, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יַצְלִיחַ Ne 2:20 +, וַיַּצְלַח 1 Ch 29:23, 2 Ch 32:30, etc.; Imv. ms. הַצְלַח 1 K 22:12 +, הַצְלִ֫יחָה Ne 1:11, יִ֯חָ֫ה Psalm 118:25, etc.; Pt. מַצְלִיחַ Gn 24:42 +;—1. make prosperous, bring to successful issue, of ´י, c. acc. of man's way (דֶּרֶח), Gn 24:21, 24:40, 24:42, 24:56 (J), c. acc. rei Gn 39:3, 39:23 (J), c. acc. Pers. 2 Ch 26:5, c. ל Pers. Ne 1:11, 2:20; abs. send success Psalm 118:25; human subj. c. acc. דֶּרֶח Dt 28:29, Jos 1:8 (D), Is 48:15, Psalm 37:7, so prob. 1:3 (al. sub 2), 2 Ch 7:11; c. acc. מִרְמָה Dn 8:25. 2. shew, experience, prosperity, of men 1 K 22:12, 22:15 = 2 Ch 18:11, 18:14, Je 2:37 (+ ל Pers. in ref. to whom) 5:28, 32:5, 1 Ch 22:11, 22:13, 29:23, 2 Ch 13:12, 14:6, 20:20, 24:20, 31:21, 32:30 (בְּכָל־מַעֲשֵהוּ), Pr 28:13, Dn 8:12 (of horn), v:24, 11:36; אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ Gn 39:2 (J) a prosperous man; subj. דֶּרֶח Ju 18:5 (cf. Psalm 1:3 supr.), ´י's word Is 55:11.

III. חלח (√ of foll.; NH צְלֹחִית = BH; cf. Aram. צְלוּחִיתָא, ፁንሕኣ፡ ፁንኣ፡ (in Lexx) flat dish; Eth. صَحنٌ Amhar. صَلَّ (v. PräAmh. Spr. § 65 c); Ar. صَلْصَلَ, all bowl, dish; v. Frä63. 170).

title: I צָלַל
content:
[Str6750] † I. [צָלַל] vb. tingle, quiver (NH צִלְצֵל whirr (rare); Ar. ܨܰܠ; Targum צְלַל; Syr. ܨܪܨܪ);—Pf. 3 pl. צָֽלְלוּ Hb 3:16; Impf. 3 fpl. תְּצִלֶּינָה 1 S 3:11, תִּצַּלְנָה (Ges§ 67 g) 2 K 21:12, Je 19:3; —tingle, of ears, at horrid sound 1 S 3:11, 2 K 21:12, Je 19:3 (all of dreadful news); of lips, quiver in terror Hb 3:16.

[Str6767] I. [צִלְצָל] n.[m.] whirring, buzzing;—cstr. אֶרֶץ צִלְצַל כְּנָפָיִם Is 18:1 land of buzzing of (insects ’) wings (so prob.; other views v. in Di).

[Str6767] † II. [צִלְצָל] n.[m.] spear (fr. whizzing);—cstr. צִלְצַל דָּגִים Jb 40:31 fish-spear, harpoon.

[Str6767] † צְלָצַָל n.m. a whirring locust (cf. As. ṣarṣaru, Ar. ܨܺܝܨܪܳܐ Syr. ܨܰܪܨܽܘܪܳܐ; Lag: Ges. Abh. 145, N. 9);—Dt 28:42 (devouring; not identif.; TrNHB 313).

[Str6767] † צֶלְצְלִים n.m.pl. musical instr. of percussion, cymbals (with clashing sound; NH צֶלְצַל, Aram. צֶלְצְלִין, ܨܺܝܨܠܴܐ) ;—´ח 2 S 6:5 (+ מְנַעַנְעִים, q. v.; ‖ 1 Ch 13:8 מְצִלְתַּיִם); cstr. צִלְצְלֵי־שָׁמַע Psalm 150:5, תְּרוּעָה v:5; —cf. NowArch. i. 272 f. 272 f. BenzArch. 277 WePsalm Psalm Eng. Tr. 232.

[Str4698] † [מְצִלָּה] n.f. bell (fr.tinkling);—pl. cstr. מְצִלּוֺת הַסּוּס Zc 14:20.

[Str4700] † מְצִלְתַּיִם n.f.du. cymbals (appar. later equiv. of צֶלְצְלִים where v. reff.);—´מ 1 Ch 13:8 (‖ 2 S 6:5 v. צֶלְצְלִים), 15:19, 16:5, 16:42, 25:6, 2 Ch 5:12, 5:13, 29:25, Ezr 3:10, Ne 12:27; תָּיִם- 1 Ch 15:16, 15:28, 25:1.

title: II צָלַל
content: [Str6749] † II. [צָלַל] vb. sink, be submerged (NH id.; As. ṣalâlu, sink down, sink to rest, II. launch (HptProl. Assyr. Gr. 1iii; BAS i. Ball, Gen. 53); Eth. ጸለለ፡ float, cf. NesMar. x: Aram. צְלַל, ܨܰܠ, are filter, clarify);—Qal Pf. 3 pl. צָֽלְלוּ כַּעוֺפֶרֶת בְּמַיִם Ex 15:10.

title: III צָלַל
content:
[Str6751] † III. [צָלַל] vb. be or grow dark (cf. Ar. خ.َلَّ be black, ظِلٌّ shade; Eth. ጸለለ፡ be dark; As. ṣllu, shade, ṣalâlu, Pi.roof over, so Sab. טַלל [II.], טלת ceiling, roof, HomChrest. 125, cf. Palm. תטלילא; OAram. טלל overshadow, Aram. טְלָלָא, ܛܶܠܳܠܴܐ shadow);—Qal Pf. 3 pl. צָֽלְלוּ שַׁעֲרֵי Ne 13:19 the gates of Jerusalem grew dark, i.e. evening came on. Hiph. Pt. חֹרֶשׁ מֵצַל Ez 31:3 a shadowing wood (but del. LXX. Co Toy Krae).

[Str6738,6752] † צֵל n.m.:Psalm 144:4 shadow;—´ח abs. 2 K 20:9 +, cstr. Gn 19:8 +; sf. צִלְ Psalm 121:5, צִלּוֺ Ez 31:6 +, also צִלְלוֺ Jb 40:22, etc.; pl. צְלָלִים Ct 2:17, 4:6; cstr. צִלְלֵי Je 6:4; —1. shadow on dial 2 K 20:9, 20:10, 20:10, 20:11 ‖ Is 38:8; צִלְלֶי־עָרֶב Je 6:4, cf. Ct 2:17, 4:6; of mt. Ju 9:36. 2. shadow, shade, as protection (fr. sun): of branches, Ju 9:15 (in allegory), Ho 4:13, Jb 40:22, Jon 4:5, 4:6 and (in fig.) Ho 14:8, Ez 17:23, 31:6, 31:12, 31:17, Psalm 80:11, Ct 2:3 (of refreshment, delight); of rock Is 32:2 (sim.); קֹרָתִי ´ח Gn 19:8 shadow of my roof; of cloud Is 25:4 and (fig. of ´י's protection) 4:6, 25:4, so prob. 16:3; כְּנָפֶיְ shadow of thy wings, fig. of ´י's protection Psalm 17:8, 36:8, 57:2, 63:8; shade, in gen., Jb 7:2, fig. of ´י Psalm 121:5; hence = protection, defence, of city (wal1) Je 48:45; of ´י Nu 14:9 (JE), Psalm 91:1 (v. also n.pr. בְּצַלְאֵל), cf. צֵל יָדוֺ Is 49:2 (covering prophet, under fig. of sword), 51:16 (covering people); of human ally Is 30:2, 30:3, of king La 4:20; also of wisdom Ec 7:12, money v:12.—בְּצִלָּהּ Is 34:15 appar. ref. to קִפּוֺז, but improb.; rd. perh. בֵּצֶיהָ her eggs Du CheHPt (CheHeb Hpt transp. וּבָֽקְעָה וְדָֽגְרָה). 3. shadow as symb. of transitoriness of life Jb 8:9, 14:2, Psalm 144:4 (כְּצֵל עוֺבֵר), Ec 6:12, 8:13; כְּצֵל נָטוּי of an individ. Life near its end Psalm 102:12, So כְּצֵל כִּנְטוֺתוֺ 109:23; in sim. of emaciated members, וִיצֻרַי כַּצֵּל Jb 17:7.

[Str6741] † צִלָּה n.pr.f. wife of Lam. Gn 4:19, 4:22, 4:23, Σελλα.

[Str6769] † צִלְּתַי n.pr.m. (Thes expl. as צִלַּת יָהּ);—1. Benj., 1 Ch 8:20, Σελαθ (ε) ι. 2. צִלְתָּי, Manassite, 1 Ch 12:21 (van d.H. v20), Σεμασθει, Σιλαθα, etc.

[Str6757] † צַלְמָ֫וֶת n. [m.] death-shadow, deep shadow, poet. (prob. = צֵל + מָוֶת, LXX. (usu.) σκιὰ θανάτου, cf. SyrVer Vulgate, so Thes SchwallyLeben n. d. Tode, 194, v. esp. NöZAW xvii (1897), 183 ff.; Ew Br and most mod. (after older comm.) rd. צַלְמוּת darkness, deepdarkness, cp. Ar. ظَلَمَ IV, As. [ṣalâmu], Eth. ጸልመ፡ be black, dark);—death-shadow, oft. ‖חשֶׁךְ, לַיְלָה etc., and opp. בֹּקֶר, אוֺר. 1. = deep shadow, darkness (cf. הַרְרֵי אֵל, אַרְזֵי אֵל): Am 5:8, Jb 3:5, 12:22, 24:17 a, 28:3, 34:22; of eyes heavy with weeping 16:16; ´בַּלְהוֺת צ24:17b terrors of the darkness. 2. fig.

a. of distress Je 13:16, Psalm 107:10, 107:14; ´אֶרֶץ צ Is 9:1. b. of extreme danger Je 2:6, Psalm 23:4, 44:20. 3. characterizing world of the dead, ´אֶרֶץ חשֶׁךְ וצ Jb 10:21, ´כְּמוֺ אֹפֶל צ v:22 (text dub., v. Bu Du); ´וְשַׁעֲרֵי צ 38:17 (LXX πυλωροὶ δὲ ᾅδου; ‖שַׁעֲרֵי־מָוֶת).

[Str6738] צִלְלוֺ, צְלָלִים, צִלְלֵי v. צֶל. above

[Str6753] † הַצְּלֶלְפּוֺנִי n.pr.f. in Judah (give shade, thou that turnest to me!) 1 Ch 4:3, Εσηλεββων, etc.

IV. חלל (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; Eth. መጸለት፡ is unleavened bread (Di: 1257 as pure, unfermented, cf. ܨܠ sub II. חלל), more prob. would be designation of shape).

חלם (√ of foll.; NöZMG xi (1886), 733 f, cp. Ar. صَلَمَ, cut off (e.g. an ear, anose);—NH חֶלֶם = BH, so As. ṣalmu, Sab. חלם Gildemeister: ZMG xxiv (1870), 180 CISiv, no. 2, 1. 4, Aram. חַלְמָא, ܨܠܡܐ, OAram. חלמא, so Nab. Palm. (also צלמתא of woman's statue)).

[Str6754] † צֶ֫לֶם n.m.: Ez 16:17 image (something cut out, cf. פֶּסֶל; Nö ‘Schnitzbild’);—´ח abs. Psalm 39:7, cstr. Gn 1:27 +; sf. צַלְמוֺ v:27, 5:3, צַלְמֵנוּ 1:26, צַלְמָם Psalm 73:20; pl. cstr. צַלְמֵי 1 S 6:5, 6:5 +, sf. צְלָמָיו 2 K 11:18, 2 Ch 23:17, צַלְמֵיכֶם Am 5:26; —1. images of tumours and mice (of gold) 1 S 6:5, 6:5, 6:11; esp. of heathen gods Am 5:26 (text dub.; del. We as gloss, cf. GASm Dr), 2 K 11:18 = 2 Ch 23:17 (both c. vb. שִׁבְּרוּ), Ez 7:20, so זָכָר ´ח 16:17 (i.e. in male form, acc. to fig. of harlotry for idolatry); מַסֵכֹתָם Nu 33:52 their molten images; of painted pictures of men Ez 23:14. 2. image, likeness, of resemblance, ´בְּ (בָּרָא) עָשָה, of God's making man in his own image, Gn 1:26(‖כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ), v:27, v:27, 9:6, ´כְּ 5:3 (‖בִּדְמוּתוֺ; all P). 3. fig. = mere, empty, image, semblance, ´בְּח Psalm 39:7 as (ב essentiae) a (mere) semblance man walks about; צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה 73:20 thou wilt despise their semblance.

[Str6756] † I. צַלְמוֺן n.pr.mont. 1. ´הַר־ח Ju 9:48 near Shechem, not identif., cf. GFM, BuhlGeogr. 100; Ερμων (erron). 2. snow-capped mt. Psalm 68:14, prob. E. of Jordan (in Hauran acc. to Wetzst, cf. BuhlGeogr. 118), Σελμων.

[Str6756] † II. צַלְמוֺן n.pr.m. a hero of David 2 S 23:28 (= עִילַי I Ch 11:29), (Σ) ελλω, LXXL Ελιμαν.

[Str6757] צַלְמָוֶת v. III. חלל

[Str6758] † צַלְמִנָה n.pr.loc. station of Isr. in wilderness Nu 33:41, 33:42, Σελμωνα.

[Str6759] צַלְמֻנָּע:12 n.pr.m. a king of Midian, + זֶבח, Ju 8:5 + 10 t. Ju 8, Psalm 83:12, Σελμανα Σαλμ.

title: צלע
content:
I . צלע (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. ضَلَعَ, decline, deviate, ضَلِعٌ curved; NH צֵלָע = BH, so Ar. ضِلَعٌ As. ṣêlu, BAram. עֲלַע, עילְעָא, Syr. ܐܶܠܥܳܐ).

[Str6763] צֵלָע:41 n.f. (m. 1 K 6:34, and appar. Ex 26:26) rib, side;—abs. ´ח Gn 2:22 +, cstr. צֶ֫לַע Ex 26:26 +, also צֵ֫לַע 2 S 16:13; sf. צַלְעוֺ Ex 25:12 +; pl. צְלָעִים 1 K 6:34, צְלָעוֺת v:3 +; cstr. צַלְעֹת Ez 41:26 +; sf. צַלְעֹתָיו Gn 2:21 +; —1. rib of man Gn 2:21, 2:22 (J). 2. rib of hill, i.e. ridge, or terrace 2 S 16:13. 3. side-chambers or cells (enclosing temple like ribs) 1 K 6:5, 6:6 (rd. ´הַצּ for היצוע, v. [יָצִיעַ]), 7:3, so of Ezek.'s temple Ez 41:5 + 10 t. 41 (on text v. Co Toy Krae). 4. ribs of cedar and fir, i.e. planks, boards (pl.), of temple wall 1 K 6:15, 6:16 floor v:15. 5. leaves of door v:34. 6. (in P) side, of ark (אֶרוֺן) Ex 25:12, 25:12, 25:14 = 37:3, 37:3, 37:5; of tabern. (מִשְׁכָּן) 26:20 (‖פֵּאָה v:18), v:26, v:27, v:27 = 36:25 (‖ ´פ v:23), v:31, v:32, 26:35, 26:35; of altar 27:7 = 38:7, 30:4 = 37:27.—Je 20:10, Jb 18:12 v. צֶלַע sub II. צלע.

[Str6762] † צֵלַע n.pr.loc. in Benj. Jos 18:28, A LXXL Σελα [(ε) λαφ]; burial-place of Saul 2 S 21:14 (צֵלָֹע), ἐν τῇ πλευρᾷ; poss. =TelAm. Zilu, so ZimZA vi. 258 JastrJBL xi (1892), 105 (Wkl, however, thinks of סלע).

title: II צָלַע
content:
[Str6760] † II. [צָלַע] vb. limp (Ar. ظَلَعَ , Aram. טלע Aph.);—Qal Pt. צֹלֵעַ עַל־יְרֵכוֺ Gn 32:32 (J; of Jacob); f. הַצֹלֵעָה as subst., of personif. Judah as flock [צאֹן] Mi 4:6, 4:7, Zp 3:19.

[Str6761] † צֶ֫לַע n. content:

content:

Pt. act. as n. smelter, refiner, hence = goldsmith Ju 17:4, Je 10:9, 10:14, 51:17, Is 40:19, 40:19 (but perhaps del. vb, cf. Du Che Marti), 41:7, 46:6, Pr 25:4; as a guild Ne 3:8, 3:32. Niph.
